name: Barberry
description: Tiny scarlet sour berries scattered over Persian rice.

tcm.note: Not classically listed as a food; the related root is a cold, bitter drug.

ayurveda.note: Daruharidra family — tikta and shita, used for liver heat.

unani.note: Zereshk is barid-yabis in Unani, given for bilious complaints.

histamine.note: Sharply sour and dried — flagged with the other sour dried fruits.
